name: ADA RAMAN Profile (TAPP-linked)
abstract: Profile for an ADA metadata document describing Raman vibrational spectroscopy products generated under a registered ramanTAPP procedure. Adds the RAMAN analysis detail on the schema:Dataset root and pins prov:used to the ramanTAPP definition, on top of the ADA RAMAN component-type constraints.
